title: Why Solar System Diagrams Are Not to Scale | Space Atlas
description: No diagram can show planet size and orbital distance accurately at the same time. Switch between size-to-scale and distance-to-scale views to see why.
ogTitle: Why Solar System Diagrams Are Not to Scale
ogDescription: Toggle between a size-accurate view and a distance-accurate view of the solar system — and see why no single diagram can be both.
jsonldName: Why Solar System Diagrams Are Not to Scale
jsonldDescription: An interactive comparison of a size-accurate and a distance-accurate view of the solar system, showing why classroom diagrams must compress one or the other.
